cases.title: Save, offline retry, refresh, submit and reopen preserve the correct result
70 fails mastery; 80 unlocks; latest zero never erases best/unlock
Student A/B, anonymous and wrong-role access are denied
Invalid input, premature results and locked levels are rejected
Concurrent submit posts one result, XP and completion event; rollback is atomic
Code quality and contract checks remain visible
HTTP load/stress produces measurable latency and reconciled accepted results
Volume preserves event identity/content at 1k, 10k and 100k
Velocity records incoming/processed rate, backlog and drain time
Supported payload variety survives the worker; invalid generator envelopes are rejected by contract
Worker redelivery and DB/Redis transport recovery preserve durable data; local backup restores
Dependency findings are recorded for triage

metrics.limitation: Invalid envelopes are checked at the generator contract boundary; this does not prove worker-side rejection of malformed internal database rows. API input rejection is covered by connected HTTP tests.
Local worker/transport/database rehearsal only. Does not prove Google login, cloud failover, R2 restore, deployment rollback or production RTO/RPO.

limitations: Synthetic PG content and email auth fixtures; not Google login, academic content approval or staging acceptance.
Local performance is a baseline with no approved production SLO; generator and application share one machine.
Manual keyboard/UAT evidence is separate; automated accessibility is not a complete accessibility certification.
Variety invalid-envelope rejection is contract/generator evidence; connected tests cover API input rejection.
Recovery is local database/worker/transport rehearsal, not cloud failover, R2 recovery or production RTO/RPO.

submitLatency.limitations: Only requests with a recorded http_req_duration point; interrupted/no-response operations are reconciled separately and not imputed as latency samples.
